verdict: M243r2 correctly and immutably closes M244's startup-domain P0. All declared SHA identities and the producer seal pass, the raw trace manifest has exactly one direct execution_trace.csv binding, and a wrong raw-trace SHA is rejected before output creation. Independent CSV parsing finds 1,840 execution records and 450 T10 ATLIF records: sample IDs 0 through 9 each contain exactly 45 unique contexts, the context-name set and per-context tile map are identical across samples, and every sample sums exactly to N=7,318,350 factor tiles. The corrected one-inference equation is 5*N+5*S with S=45: 36,591,975 candidate cycles, 1.9999877022215937x conditional module speedup and 1.0626270461798548x fixed-compute-only diagnostic. The old 36,591,755-cycle and 1.9999997267143923x values are explicitly revoked. A clean producer replay is byte-identical. Integrated RTL, matched throughput per area, trained rank3 accuracy, energy, system speedup, paper PPA and headline claims remain prohibited.

findings.title: The corrected schedule is still not an integrated executable module boundary
findings.evidence: M38-r5 proves a 669-state abstract reachable-state graph and the one-context recurrence, but integrated RTL/VCS/DC/STA/Formality remain false. M31 consumes raw T10 tiles through stage1 while M37-r10 begins from already-produced INT8 intermediates.
findings.required_fix: Build a matched serial/decoupled top or trace-driven executable cycle boundary with context barriers, shared FIFO credits and exact tags before claiming integrated throughput.

findings.title: The frozen T10 population is an opportunity census, not trained rank3 admission
findings.evidence: M243r2 correctly leaves trained_accuracy=false. The cycle substitution presumes the factorized/CSD path is usable, but trained rank3 accuracy, ATLIF-event equivalence and valid825 remain absent.
findings.required_fix: Bind performance to an admitted PAFT/rank3 checkpoint and exact downstream ATLIF-event/valid825 results; otherwise retain the conditional-opportunity qualifier.

findings.title: Configuration loading and result backpressure remain excluded
findings.evidence: The 5*N+5*S equation charges five pipeline-fill cycles per context but no configuration-load traffic or result stalls. M243r2 explicitly records both exclusions.
findings.required_fix: Keep the no-stall/resident-context qualifier on every cycle row and add these costs to any later executable trace model.

findings.title: M37's 63,114.407654 um2 remains standalone sidecar area
findings.evidence: The frozen f947 source is stage2 reconstruction only and includes private banks/FIFO while omitting stage1/shared96 integration. M243r2 correctly leaves matched_throughput_per_area=false.
findings.required_fix: Do not combine the corrected near-2x ratio with the standalone sidecar area; synthesize matched full boundaries first.

findings.title: The population is one H67 ep35 single-sequence ten-sample trace
findings.evidence: All ten samples are from zurich_city_09_a. Exactness applies to this frozen trace, not cross-sequence or dataset-wide behavior.
findings.required_fix: Retain checkpoint/s10/single-sequence qualifiers and extend the trace before making general workload claims.

allowed_claims: M243r2 directly hash-binds a frozen raw trace with 45 unique T10 contexts and exactly 7,318,350 factor tiles per inference across all ten captured samples.
For the declared conditional no-stall model, 5*N+5*S gives 36,591,975 cycles and 1.9999877022215937x module speedup.
The fixed-compute-only substitution yields 1.0626270461798548x and is not system speedup.
M243r2 explicitly revokes M243r1's old 36,591,755-cycle and 1.9999997267143923x exact values.
A wrong raw-trace SHA is rejected fail-closed, and an independent producer replay is byte-identical.
forbidden_claims: M243r1's old exact cycle values remain valid
The corrected near-2x ratio is integrated RTL throughput or matched throughput per area
The 63,114.407654 um2 sidecar is the complete candidate area
The 1.062627046x fixed-compute diagnostic is full-system speedup
The candidate has trained accuracy, power, energy or paper-ready PPA
M243r2 is a DATE headline result
